matrix.note: every cell is a documented exposure relationship with its own evidence and validity window. A product/origin pair that is NOT here has no documented route in this registry, which is not a finding that no exposure exists. Unsized cells carry a direction and no magnitude; that is the registry's state, not a rounding to zero

temporal_assumptions.policy: current monitoring admits undated reference data; not valid historical evidence

registry.note: every version that shapes a reconstruction, in one place. A replay that pins only some of these can differ from the run it claims to reproduce

completeness.strict_replay_cost: a strict replay excludes every row listed here, so the routes that depend on them disappear from any historical reconstruction. That is the correct behaviour and a real coverage gap, not a defect to be fixed by backdating
completeness.note: `known_from` is the date this system curated the record. It is never the date the underlying fact became true and never the year of the document cited; inferring one from the other is how hindsight gets into a replay

processing.note: latency is measured from the frame's `available_at` -- the latest first-sighting of the stories it was built from -- to the moment this projection was produced. It is the age of the evidence at render time, NOT a measurement of how long the running pipeline took to emit a result

manifest.note: every version that shapes this projection, pinned together. `provenance: reconstruction` means the frames here were rebuilt from stored text using the rule versions named above, which is NOT the same as replaying what the running system emitted at `decision_ts`. A saved snapshot is the only artefact that supports the second claim

coverage_gaps: Pilot coverage only: no licensed independent journalism
No validated Hindi interpretation; received Hindi items abstain
Exchange filings, Indian trade instruments and broader sector routes are incomplete
Pilot exposure registry is qualitative; unmapped firms and unknown sizes are not zero risk

supersession.note: instruments are linked on the identifiers the documents cite, or on a recorded human review. They are never linked on a similar title: one product-and-country headline covers a proposal, a determination, an order and its revocation

limitations: Qualitative mechanism hypotheses. Nothing here is a measured outcome, a loss, or a probability of loss.
Exposure relationships are documented and mostly UNSIZED; an unknown size is not a small one.
A scenario's cost base and pass-through are caller assumptions, labelled in `scenario.inputs`, not observed company data.
Frames are reconstructed from stored text with the rule versions in `manifest`; that is not a replay of what the running system emitted at the time.
The independent extraction benchmark has NOT been passed. These examples support a demonstration, not a general accuracy claim.
